title: Estimation Equivalent Circuit Battery
source_docs: Powertrain Blockset/Energy Storage and Auxiliary Drive/Network Battery/Estimation_Equivalent_Circuit_Battery.md
text: Resistor-capacitor (RC) circuit battery that determines combined voltage using lookup tables, 3 outputs; {Number of series RC pairs}, {Open circuit voltage Em table data, Em} sets the voltage table, {Series resistance table data, R0} sets the resistance, {State of charge breakpoints, SOC_BP} sets the sOC breakpoints, {Battery capacity, BattCap} sets the capacity, {Initial battery capacity, BattCapInit} sets the capacity, {Initial capacitor voltage, InitialCapVoltage}, {Network resistance table data, R n} sets the lookup table, {Network capacitance table data, C n} sets the lookup table, {Upper Integrator Voltage Limit, Vu} sets the maximum and {Lower Integrator Voltage Limit, Vl} sets the minimum. Values come from the instance.
